name: base
note: reference: the run config as setup wrote it (run this first; every other entry is compared with it)

name: workers8
note: CPU expert threads; the 6950 XT was best at 12 (of 6/8/10/12/15) on a 16-thread Ryzen

name: reserve1024
note: VRAM left free for Windows and other programs; a 12 GB card may want more

name: adapt-bg
note: background adaptive expert-cache swaps (opt-in; see tuning/LOG.md for the NaN history)

name: pin-limit-4
note: how much host memory is page-locked (default 8 GiB on Windows HIP)

name: no-mmq
note: prompt path without llama.cpp's MMQ kernels
